name: Brittany (Roscoff)
blurb: Breizh, Little Britain: Breton, a cousin of Welsh and Cornish, crêpes, and the Onion Johnnies. A ferry from Plymouth.
flight_line: The ferry slides into Roscoff past granite islands and a lighthouse. A sign on the quay says Degemer mat: welcome, in Breton. The Welsh among you will find the shape of it oddly familiar.
